Endorsement Application

Apply for an Ohio Pride PAC endorsement.

Ohio Pride PAC endorses candidates who demonstrate strong, consistent support for LGBTQ+ equality. Our Screening Committee reads your answers against your public record, and our Board votes.

Start by choosing the office you are running for. Your progress autosaves locally as you go, so you can return later on the same device.

  1. You apply. This form, one time. No interview.
  2. We review. Your answers against your public record.
  3. The Board votes. Endorse, decline, or abstain.
  4. You hear back. By email, either way.
